# 1. Load in libraries
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra) # raster handling
library(tmap) # map making
library(viridisLite)
```

# 2. Load in and prepare data
```{r}
#| message: false
#| results: hide

# Load sea surface temperature data
sst_2008 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif")
sst_2009 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif")
sst_2010 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif")
sst_2011 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif")
sst_2012 <- rast("data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif")

# Load ocean depth data
depth <- rast("data/depth.tif")

# Load EEZ data
eez <- st_read("data/wc_regions_clean.shp")

# Combining SST rasters into a raster stack
sst_stack <- c(sst_2008, sst_2009, sst_2010, sst_2011, sst_2012)
```

# 3. Process SST and depth data so that they can be combined

```{r}
# Average SST from 2008-2012 and convert from C to Kelvin
avg_sst_C <- mean(sst_stack) - 273.15

# Crop depth raster to match the extent of the SST raster
#depth_cropped <- crop(depth, avg_sst_C)


# Resample depth to match res of SST using bilinear method approach
depth_resampled <- resample(depth, avg_sst_C, method = 'bilinear')


# Checking and converting depth to match SST resolution, extent, and CRS
if (all(res(avg_sst_C) == res(depth_resampled))){
    print("The resolutions match!")
    } else {
        warning("Update resolutions to match!")
        res(depth_resampled) <- res(avg_sst_C)
        }
        

if (ext(avg_sst_C) == ext(depth_resampled)){
    print("The extents match!")
    } else {
        warning("Update extents to match!")
        ext(depth_resampled) <- ext(avg_sst_C)
        }

if (same.crs(depth_resampled, avg_sst_C)){
    print("The coordinate reference systems match!")
    } else {
        warning("Update coordinate reference systems to match!")
        crs(depth_resampled) <- crs(avg_sst_C)
        }
```

# 4. Find suitable locations

Suitable growing conditions for oysters:

* SST: 11-30 deg C

* depth: 0-70 m below sea level

Suitable growing conditions for California Spiny Lobster:

* SST: 10-21 deg C

* depth: 0-150 m below sea level



### Reclassifying SST and depth data into suitable locations
```{r}
# SST reclassification matrix
rcl_sst_oyster <- matrix(c(
    -Inf, 11, 0,
    11, 30, 1,
    30, Inf, 0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

oyster_sst_zones <- classify(avg_sst_C, rcl = rcl_sst_oyster)

# Depth reclassification matrix
rcl_depth_oyster <- matrix(c(
    -Inf, -70, 0,
    -70, 0, 1,
    0, Inf, 0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Reclassifying
oyster_depth_zones <- classify(depth_resampled, rcl = rcl_depth_oyster)
```


### Finding locations that satisfy both SST and depth conditions using `lapp()`
```{r}
# Adding oyster zone rasters
oyster_zones <- c(oyster_sst_zones, oyster_depth_zones)

# Finding locations that satisfy both SST and depth conditions
oyster_suitability <- lapp(oyster_zones, function(sst, depth) sst*depth)
```


# 5. Determine the most suitable EEZ

We want to determine the total suitable area within each EEZ in order to rank zones by priority. To do so, we need to find the total area of suitable locations within each EEZ.
```{r}
# Making EEZ crs equal oyster_suitability CRS
sf::st_crs(eez) <- terra::crs(oyster_suitability)

# Converting sf object to terra SpatVector
eez_vect <- terra::vect(eez)

# Rasterizing EEZ data
eez_raster <- rasterize(eez_vect, oyster_suitability, field = 'rgn_id')

# Calculating area of each cell
cell_sizes <- cellSize(oyster_suitability, unit = "km", mask = TRUE)

# Making sure only cells classified as 1 contribute to area totals
suitable_area <- mask(cell_sizes, oyster_suitability, maskvalues = 0)

# Selecting suitable raster cells that fall within each EEZs region

suitable_area_by_eez <- zonal(
    suitable_area, 
    eez_raster, 
    fun = 'sum', 
    na.rm = TRUE
    )

```

# 6. Creating a map of EEZ regions colored by amount of suitable area
```{r}
# Converting zonal results to a data frame
suitable_area_df <- as_tibble(suitable_area_by_eez)

# Joining suitable area to EEZ polygons
eez_map <- left_join(eez, suitable_area_df)

# Creating map
tm_shape(eez_map) +
    tm_fill(
        fill = "area",
        fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Suitable Area (km^2)"),
        fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous()
    ) +
    tm_borders(lwd = .8) +
    tm_title("Suitable Oyster Habitat by EEZ", fontface = 'bold')
```
